ImAGod.DivinePathDef.label: path of creation
ImAGod.DivinePathDef.description: You are a god who makes and keeps: harvests and walls, blades raised in defence, healing hands and patient craft. Your faithful offer you their labour, and you answer with abundance and protection.

ImAGod.DivinePathDef.label: path of chaos
ImAGod.DivinePathDef.description: You are a god of hunger and upheaval: fire and ruin, madness, desire, blood and plague. Your faithful offer you their excesses, and you answer by unleashing terrible power upon your enemies.
